resolution.note: hc host restored; app is the baseline host when hc is on PATH; KRN_TERMINAL_HOST=herdr opts out

title: The relay opens successors in the Herdr app again
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-16 (screenshots): the successor relay opened in the Herdr TUI (krn-desktop session) instead of the Herdr desktop app, while the operator is migrating fully to the app. Cause: #1108 (d80610b, S25 t-7yd86sx) deleted src/successor/host-hc.ts as an "unused host".
Outcome: the hc host adapter, its test and fixtures are restored from d80610b^, terminal-host picks hc when HC_TERMINAL_ID is set, and a relay launched from a Herdr app terminal opens in the app.
Proof: `node --test test/claude/terminal-host-hc.test.ts` passes.
Files: src/successor/host-hc.ts, src/successor/terminal-host.ts, test/claude/terminal-host-hc.test.ts, test/fixtures/hc/
